coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Non-traded REIT multi-program subscription agreement printed as pictures: the investor completes sections 1 to 6 (pages 1-2), optionally signs electronic delivery on page 3 (joint investor beside), initials the REIT representations (pages 3-4, a second box captioned Co-Owner) and signs the W-9 certification on page 4; the same again for the second program on pages 4-5 when subscribing to it; the broker-dealer's representative and branch manager complete and sign section 7 on page 2. No issuer acceptance block.

sure_per_page.1: sure; row cells with the caption at the left of each row, split where the next caption starts; the measure missed the investor rows, city rows, e-mail, title line 1, SSN row and the S-Corp/C-Corp boxes
sure_per_page.2: sure; custodian/trustee rows are completed by the investor (owner follows the form, third party also right); section 7 is the broker-dealer's
sure_per_page.3: sure; Initials boxes are captioned Owner and Co-Owner
sure_per_page.4: sure; the joint signature line is captioned joint investor or trustee/custodian of a qualified plan
sure_per_page.5: sure; same as page 4 for the second program

1: the logo and Logo Here; the Subscription Agreement heading bar; section headings; the dotted leaders before the investment amounts
2: section headings; the proxy voting note
4: letters of the acknowledgement paragraph that look like boxes
